neighbours.label: a specifying determiner or adjective that picks out a particular subset (specific, certain, these, particular) before a noun
fire: The birds use their calls to warn about specific kinds of predators in the area.
Doctors advise against putting cotton swabs in the ear, because these items can damage it.
Some patients only react to certain foods that contain high levels of histamine.
The software flags particular types of transactions for a manual review by staff.
Researchers found that specific regions of the brain light up during the task.
Avoid washing the jacket with bleach, since these chemicals weaken the fibres.
The tax credit only applies to certain categories of small business owners.
Each dialect has particular sounds that are associated with one village.
quiet: The birds use their calls to warn about all kinds of predators in the area.
Doctors advise against putting cotton swabs in the ear, because it is easy to damage it.
Some patients react badly to many foods that contain high levels of histamine.
The software sends every transaction for a manual review by staff each night.
Researchers found that large parts of the brain light up during the task.
Avoid washing the jacket with bleach, since it will weaken the fibres.
The tax credit applies to most small business owners in the country.
Each dialect has its own sounds and is spoken in one village.

notes: card: ' specific' x3, ' certain' x2, ' these' plus Russian/Arabic suffixes; mixed. Near misses use general quantifiers (all, many, any).
